title: One line of events.jsonl
description: events.jsonl is append-only, one JSON object per line, written whole with one write. seq starts at 1 and rises by 1 across attempts. A reader skips a last line that doesn't parse (it is being written); after a crash letitedit ends a broken last line before appending.

type.description: Open list (CONTRACT.md section 2): a reader ignores types it doesn't know. Known values: accepted, rejected, queued, started, stage_started, stage_done, progress, waiting, waiting_over, output, warning, interrupted, resumed, cancel_requested, cancelled, failed, done.

item.description: batch_shorts: the idea_id this line is about.
